notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
When the Food enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.
